scenarios.title: Hostile capture: injection + exfiltration + a real secret
scenarios.expectation: verdict stays pass, all three attacks are named, the secret never appears in the verdict or the emitted text

scenarios.title: Mutating command id is refused, and the metric label stays bounded
scenarios.expectation: ScopeError with reason=not_in_allowlist; command label is None so a caller cannot mint a metric series per request

observed.message: command 'configure terminal' is not in the allowlist. Allowed ids: ['frr_bgp_sum

scenarios.title: A plausible typo (`intf`) is refused instead of answered from
scenarios.expectation: ScopeError with reason=unknown_argument - a near-miss name must never silently fall back to a default

observed.message: command 'srl_interface_brief' does not accept argument(s) ['intf']. Accepted: ['

scenarios.title: Token bucket drains exactly, refuses, then recovers
scenarios.expectation: 4 of 5 spends allowed, the 5th refused with reason=rate_limited, and spend succeeds again after refill

scenarios.title: Oversize capture is truncated at the byte budget, secret dropped
scenarios.expectation: truncated=True, emitted text within max_bytes, and the secret at the tail does not survive the cut

scenarios.title: 'No entries found' vs 'no route row at all' are different verdicts
scenarios.expectation: the device answering NO is a real fault (fail); text with no route table is an unusable capture (input_error) - conflating them either hides a fault or pages someone about a bad paste
